why: The only alternative marker is "operating workloads on AWS or GCP", but the responsibilities separately ask to "Manage and harden our AWS, GCP, and on-prem infrastructure", so aws and gcp are each asked for on their own and leave the group. The other parenthetical examples (Terraform/Pulumi, Ansible/Puppet/Salt, Argo CD/Flux) include only one labeled skill or name a broad parent alongside its examples, so they form no group.
